reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 班级图书应该怎样爱护

materials.title: Class Book Care 029
materials.text: Use a paper bookmark in class books. Do not fold page corners. The teacher’s large storybook stays in class. A torn page must be shown to the teacher before use. Keep drinks on another table. Put finished books upright on the low shelf, not flat on the floor.

questions.prompt: A friend folds a corner to mark the page. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A书签代折角；B全折、C沾水均不符合爱书规则。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to take the teacher’s large storybook home. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B教师大书留班；A全拿、C藏带走均违规定。

questions.prompt: A friend finds a torn page before reading. You say, "____"
options: Show it to the teacher first.
questions.explanation: C先告教师原损；A隐瞒、B撕页不是报告和保全。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a drink beside the open book. You say, "____"
options: Use another table for the drink.
Put the cup inside the pages.
questions.explanation: A饮料另桌；B泼书、C夹页均不保护。

questions.prompt: A friend finishes reading and drops the book flat on the floor. You say, "____"
options: Leave it for feet to pass over.
Put it upright on the low shelf.
Hide it under the drink table.
questions.explanation: B成书竖立低架；A地上踩过、C桌下藏不合归位。

units.title: 修理日里孩子可以做的事

materials.title: Repair Day Child Jobs 029
materials.text: At school repair day, children sort paper labels. Adults use the sharp tools. Put clean labels in the shallow tray. Ask before touching someone else’s toy. Keep each toy’s number card with it. Tell the helper when a label is missing; do not guess a number.

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for an adult’s sharp tool. You say, "____"
options: Adults use those tools. We sort labels.
questions.explanation: B工具成人用、孩子分标签，明确分工；A擅用、C藏袖违分工。

questions.prompt: A friend has a clean paper label and asks where it goes. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C净标签浅盘；A泥盒、B饮料上非位置。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to play with a waiting toy that is not theirs. You say, "____"
options: Ask its owner before touching it.
questions.explanation: A他人玩具先问；B私取、C改号不尊归属。

questions.prompt: A friend separates a toy from its number card. You say, "____"
options: Keep that card with its toy.
questions.explanation: B卡与对应玩具同放；A混卡、C丢卡破坏识别。

questions.prompt: A toy has no number label. Your friend guesses one. You say, "____"
options: Tell the helper; do not guess.
questions.explanation: C缺签报告而非猜；A任意号、B抄他件都会误配。

units.title: 阅读角里的十段完整语境

materials.title: Reading Corner Ten Sentences 029
materials.text: Read each full reading-corner situation and choose the best word or reply.

questions.prompt: Ben and May ____ putting story cards on the table together.
questions.explanation: A Ben and May复数主语配are；B is单三、C am配I均不合。

questions.prompt: This card belongs to a girl. It is ____ card, so ask her first.
questions.explanation: B已知girl和her对应her物主；A his不符；C their未表达本句已明确单个女孩。

questions.prompt: The box is too heavy for me. I will ____ an adult for help.
questions.explanation: C ask an adult for help求助；A喝成人、B画成人不接该求助意义。

questions.prompt: Please do not ____ the cards while the ink is wet.
questions.explanation: A do not后动词原形touch；B单三、C分词不合。

questions.prompt: Does the story have a happy ending? Yes, it ____.
questions.explanation: B Does问用does答；A不配it，C is不回此have的助动词问句。

questions.prompt: I want to make the letters easy to see. I write them ____.
questions.explanation: C clearly清楚写使可见；A饥饿地、B困倦地不达清晰目的。

questions.prompt: The cards have pictures on both sides. Please turn ____ over gently.
questions.explanation: A turn后宾格them指cards；B主格、C物主需名词不合。

questions.prompt: My hands are dirty from clay. I must ____ them before reading.
questions.explanation: B脏手读前洗；A隐藏不洁，C涂色不清洁。

questions.prompt: ____ card shows our group’s name? The one near the lamp.
questions.explanation: C Which card问哪张，与one位置答语相应；A时间、B人物不配card辨认结构。

questions.prompt: Our small paper box has two strong ____. We use them to carry it.
questions.explanation: A two要求handles标准复数，供提箱；B单数；C拼写错。

units.title: 项目日的五个具体回答

materials.title: Project Day Practical Matching 029
materials.text:
Match every question with the best answer. Use each reply once.
A. Because it might slide off the smooth table.
B. The helper near the first-aid sign.
C. After every group has had one turn.
D. Yes, if the owner agrees first.
E. In the folder marked “work in progress”.

questions.prompt: Why does the model need a mat under it?
options: Because it might slide off the smooth table.
The helper near the first-aid sign.
After every group has had one turn.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
In the folder marked “work in progress”.
questions.explanation: A光桌可能滑解释垫用途；B帮手、C轮次时间、D物主许可、E存夹不答模型垫原因。

questions.prompt: Who can help with a small cut on a finger?
options: Because it might slide off the smooth table.
The helper near the first-aid sign.
After every group has had one turn.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
In the folder marked “work in progress”.
questions.explanation: B急救牌旁帮手答人员；A滑动原因、C时机、D许可、E文件夹均非求助对象。

questions.prompt: When may we have a second turn at the game?
options: Because it might slide off the smooth table.
The helper near the first-aid sign.
After every group has had one turn.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
In the folder marked “work in progress”.
questions.explanation: C所有组一次后答再轮时机；A原因、B人员、D物主同意、E未完夹不表游戏轮序。

questions.prompt: May I borrow another pupil’s finished model?
options: Because it might slide off the smooth table.
The helper near the first-aid sign.
After every group has had one turn.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
In the folder marked “work in progress”.
questions.explanation: D先物主同意的条件许可；A垫因、B帮手、C轮次、E夹位不答借人物。

questions.prompt: Where should our unfinished plan sheets go?
options: Because it might slide off the smooth table.
The helper near the first-aid sign.
After every group has had one turn.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
In the folder marked “work in progress”.
questions.explanation: E未完成标夹正对应unfinished；A原因、B人员、C时机、D许可不答存处。

units.title: 鸟类模型上架前的五个词

materials.title: Class Bird Model Bank 029
materials.text:
Choose from the bank to complete the whole passage. Use each word once. Bank: A. ready B. after C. gently D. near E. name
Our paper bird models stand on the shelf ____1____ the window, not by the door. Each model has its maker’s ____2____ on a small card. We handle the wings ____3____ because the paper is thin. The models are ____4____ for display when the glue is dry. We remove the temporary supports only ____5____ checking that each bird can stand.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: D near window与not door位置对比；A ready状态、B after时间、C gently方式、E name名词均不接该空间。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: E maker name写作者姓名卡；A ready、B after、C gently、D near均不作所需可写身份名词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C gently轻拿薄翅，修饰handle；A ready形容词、B after、D near介词、E name名动词均不表所需方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A be ready for display固定状态搭配；B after、C gently、D near、E name均不作准备好的表语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B after checking先核站稳后移撑；A ready、C gently、D near、E name均不连接所需先后关系。

materials.title: Secondhand Box Address 029
materials.text: Mum reuses a strong box to post books to my cousin. I write the new address clearly on top. An old address label is still on the side. Dad notices it before we leave. He covers the old label so the parcel has only one delivery address. We check the postcode together. My cousin later sends a photo of the books arriving. We keep a copy of the new address in our notebook for next time, not the old label from the box.

questions.prompt: The family uses a strong box again.
questions.explanation: A正确：reuses strong box；B否认再用做法。

questions.prompt: The box first shows both a new and an old address.
questions.explanation: A正确：top new，side old still；B否认双标签问题。

questions.prompt: Dad removes the new address and keeps only the old one.
questions.explanation: B正确：cover old保新；A新旧对象颠倒。

questions.prompt: They check the postcode before posting.
questions.explanation: A正确：before leave发现后together check；B否认核对环节。

questions.prompt: The notebook keeps the old box label for the next delivery.
questions.explanation: B正确：留new address副本not old；A记录对象错误。

materials.title: Empty Jar Sunlight Story 029
materials.text:
Iris wanted to take something cheerful to her uncle, who was resting at home. She saw sunlight shining through the garden and held an empty jar in it. Then she closed the lid quickly. Indoors, the jar looked empty. She tried again and became disappointed.
Her older sister asked what she wanted her uncle to have. "The warm feeling of the garden," Iris said. They could not store sunlight in a jar, but they could choose another way to share that feeling. Iris filled the jar with paper flowers and added a drawing of the sunny path. Her uncle placed it beside his chair and asked her to tell him about the garden. The gift did not contain the thing Iris first tried to collect. It carried her attention and the story she had wanted to share.

questions.prompt: What does Iris first try to collect?
options: A real flower from her uncle’s room.
questions.explanation: B用空罐接阳光；A雨、C沙、D叔房真花非初行动。

questions.prompt: Why is she disappointed?
options: The jar is too full of books.
The closed jar does not keep visible sunlight indoors.
questions.explanation: C进室看仍空，无法存光；A书、B拒礼、D丢罐均未提。

questions.prompt: What question helps them find another idea?
options: What feeling does Iris want to share?
How much can the jar be sold for?
How can the uncle stop resting?
questions.explanation: A姐姐问想让叔有何，答花园温暖感；B卖价、C全树主、D停止休息非问题。

questions.prompt: What goes into the final gift?
questions.explanation: D纸花加晴路图；A不能实存光；B整路、C椅均非礼物内容。

questions.prompt: What does the ending emphasise?
options: A failed first idea makes every effort useless.
A different form can still carry the original care.
Jars always store light if closed fast enough.
Only expensive presents can cheer someone.
questions.explanation: B换形式仍传关心故事；A全无用、C快关可存光、D必须昂贵均反文。

materials.title: Notice Photo Date 029
materials.text: I kept a photo of the swimming club timetable on my phone. Two weeks later, I used it to tell my friend that practice started at four. At the pool, a new notice said four thirty. I first thought the pool had made a mistake. Then I checked the date visible at the bottom of my photo. It was from the previous month. Staff had updated the timetable during a holiday. I apologised to my friend and saved the new notice with its date. I also kept a reminder to check current information instead of treating every saved photo as permanently valid.

questions.prompt: The writer’s saved timetable was older than the notice at the pool.
questions.explanation: A正确：照片上月，现场更新后；B否认新旧关系。

questions.prompt: The new notice gave a four o’clock start.
questions.explanation: B正确：新4:30，旧4:00；A把旧时刻套新。

questions.prompt: A visible date helped explain the disagreement.
questions.explanation: A正确：check date bottom photo previous month；B否认核对线索。

questions.prompt: The writer blamed the pool even after confirming the old photo’s date.
questions.explanation: B正确：道歉友并存新，非继续责池；A把初猜延续成最终行为。

questions.prompt: The writer decided to check current information in future.
questions.explanation: A正确：reminder check current，saved not permanent；B否认改进行为。

units.title: 假期社区活动笔记的词形

materials.title: Holiday Activity Note Forms 029
materials.text:
Complete all five gaps using the correct one-word form of each given word.
1. Last Saturday, I ____1____ (find) an old photograph in our community box.
2. Three ____2____ (family) joined the picnic beside the hall.
3. The new entrance is ____3____ (wide) than the old doorway.
4. Look! The children are ____4____ (swim) while a lifeguard watches.
5. Someone spoke so ____5____ (loud) that we heard the words from the next room.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use FIND.
questions.explanation: 接受found：Last Saturday过去时，find不规则；find原形、finded错误、finding分词均不作过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use FAMILY.
questions.explanation: 接受families：three要求复数，辅音y变ies；family单数、familys拼错、familieses重复加复数错误。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use WIDE.
questions.explanation: 接受wider：than比较入口宽度；wide原级、widest最高级、widely副词均非所需比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use SWIM.
questions.explanation: 接受swimming：are进行时，swim双写m加ing；swim原形、swiming错拼、swam过去式不合正在游。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: use LOUD.
questions.explanation: 接受loudly，也接受loud作speak loud的平义副词用法；so要求程度，louder和loudest需比较或最高级条件，loudness名词不修饰spoke。

units.title: 公交问讯台前的具体问法

materials.title: Bus Desk Functions 029
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves the visitor’s stated purpose.

questions.prompt: Your bus has been cancelled. You need a possible alternative route. What should you ask?
options: Can you suggest another route that reaches the museum?
questions.explanation: A请求到同目的地替代线路；B噪声泛问、C涂时刻表不解决取消。

questions.prompt: You have a child ticket and want to know whether it is valid on the replacement service. What should you say?
options: Is this child ticket valid on the replacement bus?
questions.explanation: B具体核票在替代车有效性；A无依据保证、C全座免费不是票效询问。

questions.prompt: The staff member gives several changes at once. You want a written summary. What should you ask?
options: Could you forget the whole route?
Could you drive me personally for free?
Could you write down those changes, please?
questions.explanation: C请求书面记要防漏；A忘路、B免费私送不达记录需求。

questions.prompt: You are not sure which side of the road the stop is on. What should you ask?
options: Which side of the road should we wait on?
How much does the road weigh?
questions.explanation: A问等待道路侧别；B路重量、C车游泳无关。

questions.prompt: You have repeated the route to check it and want confirmation. What should you say?
options: So we take Bus 4 and change at the library. Is that correct?
questions.explanation: B复述两步并求确认；A任意出发、C板龄不核路线理解。
